newsitem.title: ROMANIA: France Telecom in Romania GSM licence bid.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom in Romania GSM licence bid.

text.p: French communications group France Telecom will be part of a consortium to bid for a GSM licence offered by Romania in a tender this month, the new consortium said on Tuesday.

The Mobil Rom consortium said the French group had joined forces with Alcatel Network Systems Romania, a local branch of Alcatel, with private Media Pro media holding and ComputerLand computer retailer to try to secure one of the two lucrative GSM licences in a tender on September 26.
Tomen Telecom Romania a subsidiary of Tomen, is also part of the new consortium, Mobil Rom said in a statement.
Mobil Rom is the third consortium officially to announce its participation in the tender.
So far, 60 companies have bought the tender documents, communications ministry sources said.

The tender requires companies to be able to cover at least 65 percent of Romania with the GSM system, to have solid operating experience and "serious" financial strength to back the costs of the project.

Implementing the licences is expected to cost some $1.0 billion. The telecoms ministry says the potential market for digital mobile phones is huge in Romania, with a population of 23 million people and relatively few landlines. Romania is the last country in the region to set up a digital GSM system. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
